item.title: Backup Folder Keeps Growing, Drive Almost Full? The Ferry Deck
item.description: The backup drive is 94% full and nobody ever deleted the old copies. A calm story about a Monday when the folder finally looked after itself.

item.title: Can't Find Anything in Documents? The Lunchbox Monday
item.description: 8:10 on a Monday, a client wants a file from two years ago, and your Documents folder won't give it up. A short story about finding things again.

item.title: Client Micromanaging You? The Trailhead Car Park, 8:15
item.description: Your client wants an update every two hours, even on your day off. A quiet story about setting boundaries politely, without losing the client or your calm.

item.title: CRM Export Full of Duplicate Contacts? The Lobby at 8:40
item.description: CRM export full of duplicate contacts and the import is due today? A story about the morning panic, and the calm Monday that can follow.

item.title: CSV Names ALL CAPS and lowercase Mixed? The Lanyard Box
item.description: Half the names in the export shout, half whisper. A calm story about the badge printer, the registration table, and a Monday where names just look right.

item.title: Forgot to Log Your Time All Week? The Tram on Friday
item.description: It's Friday, the invoice is due, and your timesheet is empty. A calm story about reconstructing a week you never logged, and not having to next time.

item.title: ADHD Task Paralysis, Can't Start? The Third Lap
item.description: Ten past ten, laptop open, and you still can't begin. A quiet story about ADHD task paralysis and the small page that made starting feel possible.

item.title: AI Client Emails Sound Robotic? The Greeting Card Aisle
item.description: Your AI-written client email sounds like a stranger wrote it, and your client noticed. A quiet story about getting your own voice back in your emails.

item.title: API Authentication Secure Enough? The Soundcheck
item.description: Launch is Friday and you can't tell if your API authentication is secure enough. A soundcheck in a village hall shows a calmer way to walk into launch day.

item.title: Can Users See Each Other's Records? IDOR and Locker 14
item.description: Your API checks that someone is logged in, but does it check whose record they open? A quiet story about that doubt, and how to put it down.

item.title: C Drive Almost Full? The Red Bar at Mum's Kitchen Table
item.description: The red bar on your C drive, thousands of old installers and zips in Downloads, and a deadline. A calm story about getting your space back.

item.title: Contact Left, Invoice Unpaid? Who to Chase: The Swing Set
item.description: Your client contact left and the invoice is still unpaid. A quiet story about who to chase next, and how to do it without feeling like begging.

item.title: Client Deducted Bank Fees From Payment? The Leek Bunch
item.description: The payment arrived, but a few euros short. The client says bank fees are your problem. A Saturday market story about asking calmly for the difference.

item.title: Client Feedback by Email, WhatsApp, Phone? The Corridor
item.description: Feedback in an email, a voice note and a phone call, and you can't tell which version is current? A story about getting calm back at the start of a project.

item.title: Project Details Arrive in Pieces? The Flat-Pack Shelf
item.description: You started the work, then the client sent another 'one more thing'. A calm story about project details arriving in pieces, and a quieter way to begin.

item.title: Cron Backup Stopped After Server Update? The Bouncy Castle
item.description: Your cron backup job quietly stopped after a server update, and you only find out on a Saturday. A short story about noticing sooner and feeling calm again.

item.title: Ex-Employee Still Has Your API Keys? The Returned Laptop
item.description: A laptop comes back in a padded envelope and one question stays: who still holds the keys? A calm story for small teams after someone leaves.

item.title: Kleinunternehmer Invoice Correct? The Question on Line 2
item.description: Her client's accountant asks about one invoice and her stomach drops. A calm story for freelancers in Germany unsure their invoices are right.

item.title: GraphQL Introspection On in Production? The Tyre Pump
item.description: A message at the petrol station: your GraphQL schema is open to anyone. Now you wonder what else you left on. A story about calm after the launch.

item.title: Don't Know How to Use ChatGPT in Business? Tyre Stack
item.description: You opened ChatGPT between two customers and closed it again. A small-business story about the blank box and the quiet relief of a starting line.

item.title: Is My Webhook Endpoint Secure? The Propped Side Door
item.description: A brick holds the hall's side door open, and you realise your webhook URL works the same way. A calm story about not knowing who can knock.

item.title: Job Search Burnout, Getting Nowhere? The Windowsill Basil
item.description: Wednesday, 11:15, and the only thing you've done is water the basil. A quiet story for anyone whose job search feels like running on the spot.

item.title: Lost a Business Receipt as a Freelancer? The Blank Slip
item.description: The receipt for your new monitor is a blank strip of paper. A quiet story about lost business receipts, and what a calm year-end feels like instead.

item.title: Lost Receipts, Self-Employed? The Phone Booth Question
item.description: Your accountant asks for proof of an expense and you can't find it. A calm story about lost receipts, and what a quieter year-end can feel like.

item.title: Same Company, Four Spellings in Your CSV? The 10 am Call
item.description: One client, four spellings in your CSV export, and a call in ten minutes. A calm story about company names that won't merge, and what it costs you.

item.title: CSV Column Names Don't Match? The Fair Booth
item.description: Two exports, same data, different column names, and a buyer waiting at your stand. A calm story about merging CSV files without the afternoon of copy-paste.

item.title: Messy Excel, 40 Columns, Needed Today? The Foil Timer
item.description: A client sends a 40-column Excel mess at 10 am and wants it today. A quiet story about the afternoon that doesn't have to disappear into one file.

item.title: No Clients Booked for January? The Clementine Crate
item.description: Calendar empty after New Year and the worry is loud? A quiet Saturday market scene about turning January dread into a plan you can see.

item.title: Ran Out of Stock at Christmas? The Courier at the Door
item.description: The courier is at the door, the box is half empty, and the supplier is closed until January. A Christmas-rush story for small shops that ran out of stock.

item.title: Tutoring Income Drops Every Summer? The Sun Cream Shelf
item.description: Every July the lessons thin out and the bank balance goes quiet. A tutor, a chemist's shelf and the relief of seeing the summer coming before it arrives.

item.title: Accounts Payable Ignoring Your Invoice? The Hold Music
item.description: Three emails to accounts payable, no reply, and you're in a hospital corridor with your phone. A calm story about chasing money without feeling like you're begging.

item.title: Worried About API Mass Assignment? The Badge Desk Pen
item.description: Users could change fields they shouldn't in your API? A calm story about mass assignment worry, a conference badge desk and the relief of a clear review.

item.title: Backup Says Success, Folder Empty? The Spilled Latte
item.description: The scheduler said 'completed successfully'. The backup folder says nothing at all. A calm story about trusting your backup again, one logfile at a time.

item.title: Can't Tell Which Hours You Invoiced? The Beehive Veil
item.description: A phone buzzes mid-beehive-inspection and you can't say which hours you already billed. A short story about getting that certainty back.

item.title: Client Agreed to Pay, Stopped Replying? The Scoreboard
item.description: They said yes, the money was coming. Then silence. A story about a Saturday spent refreshing your inbox, and what calmer follow-up feels like.

item.title: Client Promised to Pay, Now Won't Answer? Kilometre 30
item.description: They swore the money was coming, then went quiet. A freelancer, a marathon crowd and a phone that stays silent: when chasing feels like begging.

item.title: Client Won't Pay, 'Not Happy With the Work'? Frame Wall
item.description: The email says they're not happy with the work, so they won't pay. A quiet story about answering calmly instead of panicking.

item.title: CSV Header Repeated Mid-File? The Dance Studio Lobby
item.description: The header row shows up again halfway down the CSV, and pandas turns every number into text. A Saturday-morning story about getting calm back.

item.title: CSV Line Breaks Splitting Rows? The Loading Bay Thursday
item.description: Half-rows, a stray line of text in column A, and a courier waiting at the door. A small story about CSV line breaks inside cells, and the calm after.

item.title: CSV Mixed Dates and Duplicates, No Time? The Badge Table
item.description: Three date formats, doubled names, and a coach leaving at ten. A short story about a messy CSV and what a calmer morning could feel like.

item.title: Thought It Was in Stock, It Wasn't? The Treatment Table
item.description: Face down on a physio table, your phone lights up: six jars ordered, and you're not sure you have six. A calm story about stock that stops surprising you.

item.title: Forgot to Keep a Mileage Log? The Odometer in the Lay-by
item.description: It's November and you never kept a mileage log. A short story about the odometer, the calendar, and finding a calm way back into your year-end admin.

item.title: Handyman Hourly Rate Too High? The Village Hall Chairs
item.description: Wednesday evening, a committee waiting, and the question every handyman dreads: what's your hourly rate? A short story about finding a number you can say calmly.

item.title: Supplier Minimum Order Too High? The Hallway Pallet
item.description: The supplier says minimum 300 units and you stand in the stockroom doorway, unsure. A calm story about ordering stock without guessing.

item.title: Massage Therapist Pricing Confused? The Gift Voucher Ask
item.description: A client asks which massage is best value, and you can't answer. A story about not knowing which of your services actually earns, and the calm after.

item.title: Music Teacher Unsure What You Earn? The Letting Desk
item.description: A letting agent asks what you earn a month from lessons, and you realise you don't know. A calm story for private music teachers.

item.title: Passwords and Tokens in Your API Logs? The Ski Boot Queue
item.description: You found a token in your API logs while standing in a ski-boot queue, and now you wonder what else you missed. A calm story about that feeling.

item.title: Ran Out of Materials Mid-Order? The Empty Thread Spool
item.description: Halfway through 40 hand-bound notebooks, the thread runs out. A calm story for makers who found out too late, and what a quiet Monday looks like instead.

item.title: Hairdresser Forgot to Charge for an Extra? The Toner Pot
item.description: You added a toner on Saturday and never rang it up. Monday morning, the numbers say so. A calm story for solo stylists who undercharge by accident.

item.title: Swagger Docs Exposed in Production? The Spare Key Label
item.description: Your Swagger page is public and a message just landed. A calm story about the knot in your stomach, and how to stop guessing while you stand in a queue.
